sourceNotes.rawContent: Elegance that jingles — this dainty Kashmiri bracelet watch features delicate red & green lotus kundan charms flanking a clean white quartz dial, all strung together on a gold chain adorned with cheerful ghungroo bells. Lighter and more subtle than traditional styles, yet deeply rooted in Indian craft heritage. Pairs effortlessly with festive ethnic wear — sarees, suits, and lehengas alike.
